subject: GSA OGP -  Phishing Resistant Authenticator - MRAS
snippet: Dear GSA Industry Partner: Link to the RFI: Take the survey Your company has been identified as a GSA Contractor that can potentially meet the needs of the below RFI...
description: The Office of Technology Policy and Federal Identity and Cybersecurity (FICS) Division is developing a product criteria to identify vendor products that are phishing resistant as outlined in OMB Memo 22-09. Phishing resistant is defined as an authentication method that is resistant to interception or replay attacks. Interception or replay attacks include: credential replay, push bombing, SS7 protocol vulnerabilities (SMS one time pin), SIM Swap. The intent of this market research is to help federal agencies identify and aggressively replace insufficient authentication methods with either phishing-resistant or passwordless methods.
